ruleDefinitions.name: T1133 — RDP to DC via Compromised Service Account (Fact #14)
ruleDefinitions.description: RDP to DC via Compromised Service Account. Trigger: Recon command chain (whoami && net user && ipconfig) within seconds of a new interactive logon
ruleDefinitions.detectionReason: A 4688 process-creation audit event was logged on {host} shortly after a new interactive logon (command detail not visible via this builder)
ruleDefinitions.suppressScope: JoinIfExists(EntityId('type: User && direction: Source'), EntityId('type: Device && direction: Source'))
